evidence.en: #1, #6, and #10 - Three of a series of photographs taken by Mr. George Adamski, beginning at 9 a.m., December 13, 1952, through his six-inch telescope. This is the "Venusian Scout Ship". About 35 feet in diameter, this small spacecraft was made of translucent metal. Photo #1 shows the large magnifying lens and the three-sphered landing gear, as well as the housing which contains the craft's main machinery underneath the ship.
